acceptanceCriteria.text: Managed PR state persists explicit repository/PR identity and exact current `PRGeneration`/head SHA.
Same-generation CI/review lifecycle changes map deterministically into bounded coarse Mottainai transitions.
Head rollover updates current generation and makes older generation-bound derived/remediation inputs stale.
Detailed Makami state is referenced/provenanced rather than replicated as a Cartesian Mottainai task-state machine.
Awaiting state requires no live LLM/Zellij session.
Restart/reconcile recovers current state by re-observing through #415 and never revives a stale implementation/remediation session.
Tests cover unchanged wait, same-generation CI delta, review delta, head rollover, merged PR, restart, and stale derived-input invalidation.

issue.title: feat: persist PR generation and map Makami deltas into coarse workflow lifecycle
